title: Steven Greenstreet's one-night visit
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Steven Greenstreet's one-night visit, about 2016-2026 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> one night. He spent one night on the ranch, and he came in obviously with confirmation bias.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange happenings, talks to a podcast host about a visit by a reporter named Steven Greenstreet. Fugal says Greenstreet spent only one night on the ranch and arrived already expecting to find nothing, which Fugal offers as a reason not to trust his account.
